_description: Frozen held-out evaluation split for Topo-Brain 3T->7T MRI synthesis.
_how_determined: create_synthesis_dataloaders passes test_fold=val_fold=0, so only fold 0 (sub-06) was held out during training. sub-07 through sub-10 were all in the training set.
_note: val and test are the same subject because create_synthesis_dataloaders uses test_fold=val_fold. sub-06 is the ONLY subject the model never trained on.
